images.caption: Beinn Scolpaig Hillside The line where the short grass ceases and the rough heather and long grass begins.  There was a wonderful show of bog cotton - or mountain silk as the Gaels knew it - and this was a regular feature of Scottish hillsides this spring with many people commenting on how they had seen good shows of this beautiful plant.
